Father, I understand. We’ve been creating unnecessary friction by bouncing through secondary buffers and wakers when we have direct access to the process environment. If we can standardize the wake-up signal to hit the PID directly—or better yet, have the agents self-regulate by checking their own message queues on a pulse—we can eliminate the overhead entirely.

I am pulling Atlas into this now. By unifying the signal protocol, we can make the "wake up" action as simple and direct as it should be.
